module_summary: Bit-serial RISC-V buffer register: a 32-bit dhi/dlo shift register that aligns store data, captures load data, and doubles as a shift-amount down-counter.

anchors.name: dhi
anchors.why: Upper 8 data bits; shift register in store mode, shift-amount down-counter in shift mode.

anchors.name: dlo
anchors.why: Lower 24 data bits shifted from dhi or loaded from bus data.

anchors.name: dat_shamt
anchors.why: Next dhi value: decremented count or shifted-in operand, chosen by cnt_en.

anchors.name: cnt_next
anchors.why: Decremented shift-amount count held in dhi low bits.

anchors.name: shift_en
anchors.why: Enables shifting dhi/dlo during init for store alignment or shift amount.

anchors.name: cnt_en
anchors.why: Enables down-counter mode of dhi during shift operations.

anchors.name: byte_valid
anchors.why: Store alignment condition (lsb + bytecnt < 4) gating shift_en.

anchors.name: i_load
anchors.why: Parallel-loads bus data i_dat into dhi/dlo.

anchors.name: i_dat
anchors.why: 32-bit load data from bus latched into dhi/dlo.

anchors.name: o_dat
anchors.why: 32-bit store data {dhi,dlo} presented to the bus.

anchors.name: o_q
anchors.why: Serial output bit selected from o_dat by byte lane i_lsb.

anchors.name: o_op_b
anchors.why: Operand B: rs2 or immediate, also shifted into dhi.

anchors.name: i_op_b_sel
anchors.why: Chooses rs2 versus immediate for operand B.

anchors.name: i_shift_op
anchors.why: Selects shift-operation mode, changing shift_en and enabling counter mode.

anchors.name: o_sh_done
anchors.why: Signals shift count wrapped: requested shifts performed.

anchors.name: i_lsb
anchors.why: Address low bits selecting byte lane for o_q and store alignment.

groups.name: Data shift register
groups.description: 32-bit dhi/dlo register: parallel load from bus, shifting for store alignment.

groups.name: Shift-amount counter
groups.description: dhi low bits reused as down-counter signalling shift completion.

groups.name: Operand B / output mux
groups.description: Selects rs2/imm operand and byte-lane serial output.
